forum.title: SensorTile in an IP65+ box ?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Andrew Neil

The sensortile.box is dust-proof but not liquid-proof.

However, this board is no longer supported.

The new sensortile.box PRO does not have a case designed to protect against dust and liquids because it is open in several areas.
forum.content_text:
There doesn't seem to be any (easy) way to get a full list of all the different "Sensor Box" variants?

In particular, is there one which has at least IP65 protection?
